title: Hydrolysis-resistant polyamide-elastomer mixtures, molded parts produced therefrom and use thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a polyamide-elastomer mixture having improved hydrolysis resistance. For this purpose, the elastomer is in particular in the form of a microgel. The polyamide-elastomer mixtures according to the present invention can be processed into molded parts for use in automotive applications, such as conduits for conducting media.
